_comment: National paid-Phase-1 / healthy-volunteer CRO directory. Verified live 2026-08-08 via Playwright+cache-buster (portals are JS-rendered + cached). pull_method tells the refresher how to scrape each. 'pay is always up-to; payout schedule + exact nights confirmed on the screening call.'

networks.name: ICON
networks.pull_method: Playwright, navigate All-Clinical-Research-Studies?nocache=<ts>#sort=compensation-high, extract a[href*=Clinical-Research-Study] (skip /Application dupes). Detail pages fetch fine for BMI.

networks.name: PPD / Thermo Fisher
networks.pull_method: trialmed.com/find-a-study; filter Male + sort Compensation-most. Only Austin & Vegas are early-phase confinement units. Night counts often hidden ('flexible start') → confirm by phone.
networks.notes: ppd.com 'Participate' routes here. Highest single check found (Vegas 3119492-MAD $40,400). Austin = in-city / zero travel.

networks.name: Fortrea
networks.pull_method: Per-study pages give exact nights + visits + BMI. $750 referral. Daytona/Madison pay $100/follow-up-visit travel stipend.
networks.notes: Dallas is a ~3hr DRIVE from Austin. Madison WI = Wisconsin friend childcare.

networks.name: Celerion
networks.pull_method: All routing via helpresearch.com; BMI/nights hidden → phone. Lincoln = ~1hr drive from Omaha.

networks.name: Altasciences
networks.pull_method: Each site is participants<code>.altasciences.com. BMI not posted (screening-gated) → confirm on call. Pays via ClinCard.
networks.notes: Overland Park KS = ~3hr DRIVE from Omaha, highest US net pay in the Midwest pull.

networks.name: Spaulding Clinical
networks.pull_method: Publishes BMI + nights + pay openly. Min weight 110 lb.
networks.notes: West Bend WI = Wisconsin friend childcare. 'Solar' = $6,625 / 4 nights, standout velocity.

networks.name: Nucleus Network
networks.pull_method: Publishes full BMI/nights/pay. Filter to Minneapolis.
networks.notes: ~1hr flight / ~6.5hr drive from Omaha. Highest open study is female-only.

networks.name: Frontage Clinical Services
networks.pull_method: Per-study BMI (18-32) + nights posted. 160-bed unit <10mi from NYC.
networks.notes: Philly/NYC friend childcare. Best East-Coast healthy-volunteer pay.

networks.name: BioPharma Services
networks.pull_method: volunteer-hub lists studies; BMI/nights per-study by phone. CAD pay.
networks.notes: Mostly Ontario residents (operational, not a bar). US citizen w/ passport typically OK — confirm.

networks.name: Worldwide Clinical Trials
networks.pull_method: 200-bed unit. No normal-BMI study open 2026-08-08 (only an obese GLP-1, cohort full).
networks.notes: ~1.5hr DRIVE from Austin. Get on the healthy-volunteer list for the next panel.

networks.name: Clinical Pharmacology of Miami (CPMI)
networks.pull_method: Healthy roster NOT web-listed (MyTrial app / phone). Legit early-phase (FIH, hepatic/renal). Call.

networks.name: QPS
networks.pull_method: Roster skews obese/patient now. Apply to volunteer DB; healthy FIH rotate in.

networks.name: Biotrial
networks.pull_method: biotrial.com US volunteer → trialmed.com. Newark not in current active-clinic list → CALL to confirm CPU still enrolling healthy volunteers.

networks.name: JBR / Jean Brown Research (CenExel)
networks.notes: CenExel's healthy-volunteer arm = JBR in SLC. SLC = friend childcare. West/SLC agent detail pending.

networks.name: DM Clinical Research
networks.notes: Phase 2-4 outpatient community trials — NOT a Phase-1 healthy-confinement unit. Deprioritize.

networks.name: Innovaderm Research
networks.notes: Dermatology PATIENT CRO; one low-pay ($615 CAD) healthy slot. Deprioritize.

gaps.jalr_value: For short stays of 10 days or less, you will typically receive your money in a lump sum in the mail once the study is completed. For longer single stay studies, you will typically get most of the money on your last check out and the rest in the mail about two weeks later. For longer studies that are broken up into multiple periods, you will typically but not always, get a few checks, usually starting with your second and on stays and the rest in the mail once you complete the study. This is not guaranteed! This is just the way it’s been so far but the polices can always change. According to PPD written policy in the informed consent, they reserve the right to issue payment within 3 weeks of completion of study, so it is a courtesy that they offer multiple checks when time constraints allow.
